summary: Project weighted structural and functional node degrees onto the Mapzebrain atlas as a split-hemisphere anatomical map — z-scored SC degree colouring the left-brain region centroids, z-scored FC degree colouring the right-brain centroids, over the XY (dorsal) atlas projection.
use_when: Analyze structural and functional node degree projected onto the atlas
Generate structural and functional node degree projected onto the atlas outputs
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
